text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ Finished putting up the posters! And 
I beat my best time again!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is to contact my manager 
and take next week off~..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'll invite Trainer too.

First thing in the morning when I unlocked 
the trainer's office, Ines Fujin came 
rushing in, completely out of breath.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo~, Trainer! I've got an 
invitation for you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Are you free this weekend? Let's go on a 
date to Kyoto together!"

And after hearing Ines Fujin's plan, the 
place we headed to was—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa! The Tenno Sho (Spring)!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I heard Ryan-chan and McQueen-chan were 
coming too, so this is a "Let's check in 
on how the two of them are doing!" 
meeting!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Since I'm a Front Runner, right? I 
don't usually get a chance to take a good, 
hard look at the two coming up from 
behind.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So if you're gonna stare and observe, the 
spectator seats are the best spot, right? 
Plus—
(Woooooaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! Ryaaan!! Show 'em what the Mejiro 
family is made of—!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
......Amazing. Just the two of them 
walking out created this much hype...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Both Ryan-chan and McQueen-chan too...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~~! You both look wonderful~! Please, 
win this by all means~~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Everyone watching Ryan-chan and the 
others has sparkling eyes, don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan and the others have been racing 
while all these eyes are glued on them...

And the gates opened for the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen takes the lead! Mejiro 
McQueen is in front!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Can Mejiro Ryan break into the battle for 
second place?! McQueen is still in the 
lead! Unchanged! And McQueen crosses the 
line in first place!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...So strong.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
As expected of McQueen-san! Brushing off 
even that immense pressure, she 
brilliantly fulfilled the long-cherished 
Mejiro ambition...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Still, for Lady Ryan to finish in 4th 
place... To think she didn't even make it 
into the top 3...

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"Is Lady McQueen truly the one who will 
lead the Mejiro family from here on out 
after all...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...! Everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost today, but I will seize 
glory next time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only one in the Mejiro 
family! I'll make sure to show everyone 
that Mejiro Ryan is here too, right at the 
Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
...! That's right!! That's right, isn't 
it, Ryan-sama! I will continue to support 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Ryan-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(If I had finished in Ryan-chan's place, 
would words like that have come out of my 
mouth right away?)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...No, I can't. I'm sure I'd look visibly 
frustrated. That's probably the difference 
between me and Ryan-chan right now.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...This is what an Umamusume looks like 
when carrying everyone's expectations.
choice_data_list:
Have you finished researching the 
competition?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Mm-hmm, so chewy! It was totally worth 
coming all the way to Kyoto!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So these are the girls I'll be clashing 
with in the Takarazuka Kinen...!

Ines Fujin kept her eyes fixed on the 
figure of her best friend and rival.
